scripts.build: tsc && vite build && node scripts/check-production-e2e-boundary.mjs dist
scripts.e2e: npm run e2e:build && npm run e2e:test && npm run e2e:verify
scripts.e2e:build: npm run qa:rendering-corpus && npm run e2e:build-app
scripts.e2e:build-app: npm run tauri build -- --debug --no-bundle --features e2e --config src-tauri/tauri.e2e.conf.json
scripts.qa:ocr-corpus: node scripts/generate-ocr-corpus.mjs qa-fixtures/ocr-corpus && node scripts/check-ocr-corpus.mjs qa-fixtures/ocr-corpus
scripts.qa:ocr-engine: npm run qa:ocr-corpus && node scripts/run-ocr-engine-corpus.mjs qa-fixtures/ocr-corpus
scripts.qa:certificate-engine: npm run qa:rendering-corpus && node scripts/run-certificate-engine-corpus.mjs qa-fixtures qa-fixtures/certificate-engine
scripts.qa:pdfa-engine: npm run qa:ocr-corpus && node scripts/run-pdfa-engine-corpus.mjs qa-fixtures/ocr-corpus qa-fixtures/pdfa-engine
scripts.qa:rendering-corpus: cargo run --manifest-path src-tauri/Cargo.toml --example generate_pdf_fixtures -- qa-fixtures && node scripts/check-rendering-corpus.mjs qa-fixtures
